name: Task-relevant representation fidelity under load, delay, and interference
operational_definition: The capacity of a PFC-centered distributed neural system to encode, maintain, update, protect, and use a task-relevant representation with sufficient fidelity despite increasing information load, elapsed delay, competing information, or context change.

insulin_IGF_regulatory_axes.interpretation_rule: Do not infer pathology from high or low basal signaling alone. Prefer dynamic ligand-response measurements and preserve ligand, receptor, IRS branch, cell type, region, and disease stage.

competing_final_models.name: representation_stability_trophic_homeostasis
competing_final_models.prediction: Different disorders converge on failure of cellular and circuit homeostasis required to preserve task representations; insulin/IGF is one major regulator of this homeostasis.

competing_final_models.name: disease_specific_entry_common_downstream_phenotype
competing_final_models.prediction: Distinct upstream insults converge on the same executive-network representation-fidelity phenotype through partly different molecular routes.

competing_final_models.name: feedback_amplification
competing_final_models.prediction: Primary pathology can induce insulin/IGF dysregulation, which then amplifies synaptic/network instability; direction and magnitude vary by stage and compartment.

competing_final_models.name: insulin_IGF_epiphenomenon
competing_final_models.prediction: Insulin/IGF changes track network failure without materially mediating it; causal rescue should fail after controlling the primary disease process.
